messages:
maya_cs: Heads-up — Pegasus preview cohort (10 accounts) is ready for beta onboarding next week. Main asks: 1) schedule kickoff 2) confirm integration flags 3) collect initial feedback plan. I'm proposing sessions Mon/Tue 9–11am PT. Who can lead tech walkthrough? :wave:

sam_se: I can lead the walkthrough Mon 9:30 PT. Need model keys + sample dataset. @devon_engineer can you provision a sandbox with a 4-GPU job and sample telemetry?

devon_engineer: On it. I'll spin up a ded pool with 2 x A10G, create service account, and drop creds in the shared vault. ETA EOD Fri. I'll post the command and a short runbook.

devon_engineer: ```bash
# create pool
rwdctl pools create --name pegasus-sandbox --gpus 2 --type dedicated
# service account
rwdctl iam create --name pegasus-beta-sa --roles inference.run
``` 

jordan_pm: Also need a short one-question NPS + 3 focused followup prompts after first week. I'll draft a Google form and add to the onboarding flow. @maya_cs can you confirm the timing for the week-1 survey?

maya_cs: Week-1 sounds right. Also let's capture a screenshot task to validate output quality from users. I'll add it to the checklist.

tia_successmgr: FYI one of the accounts (Orion Health) flagged renewal concerns if onboarding drags. Their CSM asked for an executive touchpoint after onboarding. Recommend we schedule a 30-min exec sync 2 weeks post-kickoff.

sam_se: Noted. I'll add a calendar invite tentatively for 2 weeks out and tag it 'exec sync — Orion Health'.

maya_cs: Can someone own feedback triage? We need someone to consolidate defects, model regressions, and UX asks into the backlog.

jordan_pm: I'll triage initial feedback for first 2 sprints; if volume grows we escalate to eng triage board.

devon_engineer: Agree. I'll add a label `pegasus-preview` on issues and enable a nightly export to the dashboard.

maya_cs: Logistics: shared calendar link https://cal.example.com/pegasus-kickoff — please RSVP. Also attach the onboarding checklist: 1) invite devs 2) gen keys 3) run smoke test 4) run sample prompts 5) submit feedback form.

sam_se: RSVP'ed. Quick question — for private deployments, do we have a standard NDA addendum? Orion wants SOC-level notes.

tia_successmgr: There's a one-page compliance addendum we share for previews. I'll DM the legal template and confirm SOC hint.

oncall_bot: Incident alert: Ded pool creation failures detected in eu-west-1 between 10:12–10:18 UTC — 4 failed jobs. Tagging @devon_engineer

devon_engineer: Seen. Investigating — looks like quota bump failing; raised ticket with infra (23456), will update thread.

maya_cs: Thanks. If pool creation hits delay, fallback plan: use hosted instances temporarily for onboarding to avoid slippage.

sam_se: Can we get sample tokens with limited scope for hosted fallback? @devon_engineer

devon_engineer: I'll create scoped hosted tokens: expires in 14 days, limited to pegasus-kickoff namespace.

jordan_pm: I'll prepare the week-1 feedback form + rollout email copy. Draft ready by Fri EOD.

maya_cs: Great. Recap: Sam leads walkthrough, Devon provisions infra & tokens, Jordan owns feedback triage and form, Tia handles compliance & exec sync for Orion. Will follow up with calendar invites and checklist updates. :rocket:

sam_se: :thumbsup:

devon_engineer: ETA update — quota ticket 23456 created with infra, expect resolution by Mon morning.

jordan_pm: Draft form link: https://forms.gle/abc123 — comments welcome.

tia_successmgr: Received legal addendum, sending to Orion CSM now.

maya_cs: Closing loop — I updated the Pegasus program board and pinned the checklist. Thanks everyone.
